preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist of exactly n lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'NO' or 'YES' followed by two indices.
